# NS2 training-data flight card (generated by `experiments/analysis/ns2_training_flight_card.py`)

119 flights, all with the study tree strategy S0 (`tree_S0.patch`: Omar geometric on both drones, NS2 off, deck RPM on), dedicated training data, NOT study repeats. **Flown WITHOUT `--study`** (the readback gate returned NaN on 2026-10-15; the training data does not need it): the strategy is read from the log (`experiments/analysis/tree_log_check.py`) and the file is tagged `ns2_train` at copy time.  Prerequisite: lab validation of the tree (`docs/lab_sessions/next_session_plan.md`). Labels are reconstructed offline (`docs/plan_ns2_retrain_data_2026-10-14.md` §1). Abort rule protocol §4; fresh batteries; one uSD file per flight.
